performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but GBP collapse and 3 overdue milestones threaten August scoreboard.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07), sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14), and renewal close (due 2026-07-23) are all overdue — 3 blockers on the August scoreboard.
CPL fell 22.59% WoW on spend down 16.63% while leads grew 7.69% — efficiency is confirmed improving vs this client's own recent baseline of ~$10.02 CPL.
3-day signal (Aug 24–26): spend avg $28.69/day vs prior 3 (Aug 21–23) avg $23.49 — leads avg 5.7 vs 1.7, trend recovering after Aug 21–23 zero-lead dip.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on Aug 25–26 vs a 45-day avg of ~7.8/day — 72.29% 7d drop signals organic discovery is effectively offline, not just slow.
GHL shows 96 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — leads arriving but pipeline shows no scheduling conversion, likely an intake/tagging leak not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 3 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; unblock attribution and sync before August closes.
suggestions.monday_update: Three milestones are overdue: renewal close (Jul 23), phone-match attribution gap (Aug 7), and sync/contact cleanup (Aug 14). Without phone-match attribution, legitimate leads cannot be traced to scheduled patients — the client's primary scoreboard metric. Nacer to assign owners and confirm completion dates by 2026-08-29. Success check: all 3 items marked done in Monday with evidence by 2026-08-29.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL pipeline: 96 opps created, 0 appointments in 28 days — confirm intake process and Lily sync are routing leads to booking.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 96 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won in the 28-day window. This is not an ads problem — leads are arriving at $10.02 CPL. The likely cause is a broken handoff between GHL lead intake and the booking step (Flex Dental or front-desk follow-up). Review the biweekly Lily sync notes and confirm whether leads are being contacted and offered appointments. Success check: at least 1 confirmed appointment recorded in GHL by the next Lily sync (target 2026-08-29).

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 on Aug 25–26 vs 45-day avg 7.8/day — re-check after 3 more days to confirm outage or permanent decline.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 25 and 26, against a 45-day average of approximately 7.8 actions per day. A 72.29% weekly decline is confirmed. If this holds for 3 more days it becomes a confirmed channel-dark signal requiring active GBP remediation. No action yet — verify the GBP listing is live and unpunished. Re-check on 2026-08-30.
